entities.name: Deborah
entities.description: One of the two speakers. A yoga teacher who teaches classes, runs workshops and community events and started a neighbourhood class in March 2023; married, keeps two cats, Luna and Max, and speaks constantly of her late mother, whose old house she visits. Her father died suddenly on 25 January 2023 and her friend Karlie died in February 2023. She met Jolene on 23 January 2023 and the two exchanged messages through to September 2023.

entities.name: Jolene
entities.description: One of the two speakers. An engineering student who finished a robotics project in May 2023 and then interned at a well-known engineering firm; she keeps two pet snakes, Susie and Seraphim, has been with her partner since about 2020, and has done yoga and meditation sporadically for about three years as of 2023. Her mother died in 2022.

entities.name: Anna
entities.description: Deborah's neighbour, whom Deborah met on 31 January 2023 at yoga in the park. Anna attends Deborah's yoga classes, wears a pendant in memory of her own mother, brought Deborah a vegan stir-fry in early March 2023, sat with her by the sea watching a sunset, started a running group with her in July 2023, and heard Deborah's life story on 18 August 2023.

entities.name: Karlie
entities.description: A friend of Deborah's who died in the week before 22 February 2023. The last photograph of the two of them together was taken in the summer of 2022, on a hike they both enjoyed.

entities.name: Jolene's partner

properties.aliases: my partner; my boyfriend; my bf; my significant other

entities.description: Jolene's long-term partner, never named in the conversation. They met in an engineering class at college, had been together three years as of 25 February 2023 and are not married; he wears a ring that is a decoration rather than a wedding ring. They play video games together, he sometimes joins her for yoga, and they travelled together to Rio de Janeiro in August 2023 and to a meditation retreat in Phuket in September 2023. His father taught him to stay determined, and he has creative ambitions.

entities.name: Deborah's husband
entities.description: Deborah's husband, never named. They married on the beach Deborah loves, used to play video games together — detective games by preference — and enjoyed the outdoors together. He was photographed in front of Deborah's mother's old house in 2023.

entities.name: Deborah's mother

properties.aliases: my mom; my mum; my mother

entities.description: Deborah's mother, who died a few years before January 2023 and is the subject Deborah returns to most. She sat on the bench by her window every morning for the view and every night with a book; her hobbies and passions were reading, travel, art, flowers and cooking, and she baked Deborah pineapple birthday cakes. She came to Deborah's early yoga classes as her biggest supporter, owned the cat Max, married Deborah's father in 1993, and used to sit with Deborah on a bench in the park near her house talking about dreams and life.

entities.name: Deborah's father
entities.description: Deborah's father, who died suddenly on 25 January 2023, a loss that left the family shell-shocked. He married Deborah's mother in 1993.

entities.name: Jolene's mother
entities.description: Jolene's mother, who died in 2022. She gave Jolene a heart-shaped pendant with a bird on it in Paris in 2010, played video games with her — Monster Hunter: World among them — and always told her never to give up, a value Jolene carries into her engineering work.

entities.name: Jolene's father
entities.description: Jolene's father, who was always supportive of her gaming although he did not play with her; her parents together gave her the games console when she was ten that started her passion for video games.

entities.name: Nils Frahm
entities.description: A musician Jolene loves listening to during her yoga practice, named on 28 March 2023 alongside Olafur Arnalds as putting her in a different headspace.

entities.name: Olafur Arnalds
entities.description: A musician Jolene loves listening to during her yoga practice, named on 28 March 2023 alongside Nils Frahm as calming.

entities.name: Susie
entities.description: One of Jolene's two pet snakes and the first she showed Deborah, on 27 January 2023. Jolene said on 1 August 2023 that she had adopted her two years earlier when she was lonely and wanted company, and on 15 September 2023 that she had had her for two years. Susie helps her through difficult times and is a calming companion.

entities.name: Seraphim
entities.description: Jolene's second pet snake, which she said she got in 2022. Seraphim once slid out of her cage and coiled up beside Jolene during a video game; Jolene took her to the park on 26 February 2023 and bought her a new aquarium on 24 June 2023.

entities.name: Luna
entities.description: One of Deborah's two cats, taken from a shelter, and five years old as of 26 August 2023. Deborah says she takes her cats out to the park morning and evening.

entities.name: Max
entities.description: Deborah's other cat, originally her mother's; Deborah took him in when her mother died. He was eight years old as of 26 August 2023.

entities.name: Deborah's mother's old house

properties.aliases: my mother's old house; my mom's house; my old home; her old house

entities.description: The house Deborah's late mother lived in, and the place Deborah returns to most. It has a bench by a window where her mother sat every morning and read every night, a garden, and a spot by the water nearby where Deborah reflects. Deborah does yoga there, visited it in the week before 23 January 2023, in July 2023 and on 10 September 2023, and went to a yoga retreat near it in August 2023.

entities.name: Paris
entities.description: The city where Jolene's mother gave her the bird pendant in 2010, and where Jolene said on 27 January 2023 that she had bought one of her snakes a year earlier.

entities.name: Bali
entities.description: The island Deborah travelled to in 2022 and called one of her favourite trips: gorgeous, peaceful and great for yoga.

entities.name: Bogota
entities.description: Where Jolene spent a holiday in the summer of 2022; she photographed the sunset over the water there and found it beautiful and calming.

entities.name: Rio de Janeiro
entities.description: The city Jolene and her partner returned from on 29 August 2023 after a trip of yoga classes, cafes, excursions and an old temple with long stairs. Deborah had also visited it about three years before August 2023.

entities.name: Phuket
entities.description: Where Jolene and her partner went on a meditation retreat, travelling there over the weekend of 9-10 September 2023; a session there on releasing expectations and savouring the present stood out for her.

entities.name: Thailand
entities.description: The country Jolene names for the retreat at Phuket, where she and her partner tried a new style of meditation using flowers.

entities.name: The park near Deborah's house

properties.aliases: this park near my house; a park with a forest trail; a nearby park

entities.description: The park Deborah loves near her home, with a forest trail and a beach. She had her first morning jog there on 24 February 2023, does yoga and reflects there, takes her cats out there morning and evening, and it holds a bench of special meaning where she and her mother used to sit and talk about dreams and life.

entities.name: Mount Talkeetna
entities.description: The mountain on top of which Jolene did yoga on the morning of 5 June 2023, during her internship.

entities.name: Deborah's yoga classes

properties.aliases: my yoga class; the neighbourhood class; my classes; my workshops and events

entities.description: The yoga classes, workshops and events Deborah teaches and organises. Members sent her a thank-you letter on 26 January 2023; she started a class for her neighbours on 10 March 2023, bought new props for it in March, organised a yoga event with food stalls and live music in July 2023, led a session for elderly residents of a care home in August 2023, and teaches on the beach. Anna is one of her regulars, and Deborah calls the group her second family.

entities.name: Deborah's running group
entities.description: The running group Deborah started with her neighbour Anna, announced on 9 July 2023. Its members help and push each other during runs, which Deborah says makes it much easier to stay motivated.

entities.name: Jolene's engineering school

properties.aliases: engineering school; college; my studies; my classes

entities.description: The engineering course Jolene studies on. Her professor set her a large robotics project in February 2023; she met her partner in an engineering class there; she struggled with assignments in March, with exams and deadlines through the spring, and had finals in September 2023.

entities.name: The engineering firm where Jolene interned
entities.description: The well-known but unnamed engineering firm where Jolene was interning as of 6 June 2023. She valued applying what she had learned at school to real projects and found her colleagues' enthusiasm inspiring, but struggled to find work-life balance there.

entities.name: Sapiens
entities.description: The book on human history and technology's effect on people that Jolene said on 4 February 2023 she was really into and that was giving her a lot to think about.

entities.name: Avalanche
entities.description: The novel, attributed by Jolene to Neal Stephenson, that she read in one sitting about two weeks before 4 February 2023.

entities.name: Detroit
entities.description: The console game Jolene and her partner played together in the week before 27 January 2023.

entities.name: Walking Dead
entities.description: The game Jolene and her partner planned to play on Saturday 28 January 2023, named when Deborah asked whether they only played old games.

entities.name: It Takes Two
entities.description: The competitive team-strategy game Jolene and her partner love playing together and which she says is a great way for them to bond.

entities.name: Zelda: Breath of the Wild
entities.description: The open-world Switch game Jolene recommended to Deborah on 19 August 2023 as awesome.

entities.name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
entities.description: The game Jolene recommended to Deborah on 19 August 2023 as really calming and cute.

entities.name: Overcooked 2
entities.description: The chaotic co-op cooking game Jolene and her partner often play for bets; she once won three large pizzas off him.

entities.name: Monster Hunter: World
entities.description: One of Jolene's favourite games and one she used to play with her mother, loved for its immersive story and open world.

entities.name: Battlefield 1
entities.description: The game Jolene and her partner were given for their console in the week before 21 August 2023.

entities.name: Savana
entities.description: An instrumental track Deborah named on 28 March 2023 as one of her favourites for creating a peaceful vibe during yoga.

entities.name: Sleep
entities.description: The album Deborah listens to and recommended to Jolene on 28 March 2023 as great for meditation and deep relaxation.

entities.name: Jolene's bird pendant
entities.description: The heart-shaped pendant with a bird on it that Jolene's mother gave her in Paris in 2010. Its symbol represents freedom to Jolene and reminds her to go for her goals and not be held back.

entities.name: Deborah's amulet from her mother
entities.description: The pendant, also called an amulet, that Deborah keeps in memory of her mother and brings with her whenever she visits the spot by the water near her mother's old house; holding it brings her comfort.

entities.name: Yoga
entities.description: The practice at the centre of Deborah's life: she teaches it, runs workshops and retreats around it, and does it in parks, on beaches and at her mother's old house. Jolene practises it too, sporadically for about three years as of mid-2023, and her partner sometimes joins her. Poses named in the conversation include Warrior II, a chair-supported twist, the Dancer Pose, the tree pose and savasana.

entities.name: Meditation and mindfulness
entities.description: Meditation and mindfulness, practised by both women and referred to under both names. Deborah began with workshops and books, says mindfulness is now a huge part of her life and made a meditation guide for her yoga retreat; Jolene uses it to cope with stress, signed up for a meditation course on 6 September 2023 and went on a meditation retreat in Phuket.

entities.name: Video gaming
entities.description: Playing video games, Jolene's long-standing hobby since her parents gave her a console when she was ten; she taught herself, plays with her partner, and uses it to de-stress. Deborah used to play with her husband, preferring detective games, and had not played for a while as of August 2023.

entities.name: Surfing
entities.description: Surfing: Deborah discovered her love of it at the beach where she married and has surfed. Jolene has wanted to learn since March 2023 — gathering information, watching videos and buying a beginners' guide — but had still not been by 17 September 2023, when the two agreed to go together the following month.

entities.name: Running
entities.description: Running: Deborah went for her first morning jog on 24 February 2023, made it part of her daily routine, and started a running group with Anna in July 2023.

entities.name: Gardening
entities.description: Gardening and plants: Deborah finds comfort in a garden of roses and dahlias, loves sharing her love of plants, and ran a free gardening class for the community with her neighbour on 16 September 2023.

entities.name: Jolene's robotics project
entities.description: The large robotics project Jolene's engineering professor set her, first described on 1 February 2023. She found new solutions for it at a retreat in February, had a breakthrough on 24 March 2023, called it a big project taking shape in April 2023, and finished it in May 2023; the result was a solar-powered vehicle. Referred to variously as a huge robotics project, my engineering project and a big project I've been working on lately — joined here as one project because the dates and details line up.

entities.name: Jolene's water purifier
entities.description: The sustainable water purifier Jolene planned, designed and built for a rural community in need, a milestone she reached in the week before 4 February 2023 and called a huge accomplishment for her as an engineer. Seeing it deliver clean water gave her a sense of purpose.

entities.name: Jolene's aerial surveillance prototype
entities.description: The prototype Jolene was working on as of 12 August 2023: a more productive and affordable aerial surveillance system intended to help with emergency response and environmental monitoring.

entities.name: Jolene's STEM volunteer programme
entities.description: Jolene's idea, put to Deborah on 9 February 2023, for a volunteer programme in which engineers teach STEM to underprivileged children through workshops with local schools and centres, with engineers as guest speakers. She had sketches in her planner but had approached nobody, wanting to solidify the plan first.

entities.name: Deborah's community cleanup
entities.description: The community cleanup project Deborah started and raised funds for, announced on 1 August 2023; she was glad to see everyone come together to make a difference.

claims.text: Jolene said on 12 September 2023 that she and her partner had travelled the previous weekend, 9 and 10 September 2023, to a meditation retreat in Phuket for a few weeks, and that the nature, the reflection and the break from her engineering studies helped her find inner peace.
claims.speaker: Jolene

claims.text: At the Phuket retreat Jolene had time to reflect on what makes her happy and realised she needs relaxation, self-care and balance alongside her engineering studies; she found the beauty of the nature there inspiring and refreshing.
claims.speaker: Jolene

claims.text: The session at the Phuket retreat that stood out for Jolene was about releasing expectations and judgements and savouring the present — a reminder not to dwell only on the finish line, since she usually gets too consumed with hitting her goals.
claims.speaker: Jolene

claims.text: Jolene said on 12 September 2023 that she was trying to be more mindful and grateful about small things such as the feeling of the sun or a great cup of coffee, and that she was experiencing a new level of joy and happiness.
claims.speaker: Jolene

claims.text: Deborah recently played a card game about cats whose name she could not remember, in which players take cards one by one from a deck and attack their opponent with them, and she said on 12 September 2023 that she would play it with Jolene.

claims.text: Between 12 and 15 September 2023 Deborah reconnected with her mother's old friends; their stories made her tear up and reminded her how lucky she was to have had her mother.

claims.text: Hearing her mother's friends tell stories was both happy and sad for Deborah, since she heard things she had not heard before; overall it was comforting and gave her a glimpse of her mother's life beyond what she knew, which made her appreciate her more.

claims.text: Deborah and her mother's old friends spent their day together reminiscing and looking through her mother's photographs, which Deborah found really sweet.

claims.text: Deborah and her neighbour ran a free gardening class for the community on 16 September 2023, which people of all ages joined; Deborah loved sharing her love of plants and helping people take care of the world.

claims.text: Deborah's mother had a big passion for cooking and made amazing meals for the family; Deborah still remembers the smell of her special dish filling the house and bringing everyone together.

claims.text: A blossom tree near Deborah's home bloomed every spring, and watching it was like admiring nature's artwork: it filled her with awe and made her appreciate the beauty of life and the hope of growth even in tough times.

claims.text: Jolene photographed a plant growing out of the corner of a building as a reminder that she can keep growing through any obstacle and that there is always something positive to hang on to.
